_what_this_is: Every Gen2 Zero this project has actually measured, as DERIVED READINGS.
No capture content lives here and none ever should - these are the numbers
the analysis produced, with enough provenance for a reader to weigh them.
It exists because the tool's calibration base used to live in docstrings and
comments, where a user could not read it and a threshold could not cite it.
n=2 is not a population. Nothing here supports the word 'normal': what two
bikes support is a COMPARISON - your reading beside a named bike's, with
both sets of conditions shown. See condition.comparison_lines, which
refuses any comparison whose either side is below the floor for it.
